notes.title: Update 2.0 & 20% off!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27156172/edb0064597b20ddf8e3e227849f7ac9152bde73f.png[/img]

Greetings Divers!

We are happy to announce that Update 2.0 is now available for download! Enjoy the newly added destructible elements, survival mode and removal of the StarForce DRM.

[h1]20% OFF FOR A LIMITED TIME ONLY[/h1]
To celebrate this occasion, we are offering VR Invaders at a special discount of 20% off the regular retail price. Make sure to make use of this limited time offer - only available until 5th of March 2017!

[h1]UPDATE 2.0 AVAILABLE[/h1]
To find out more about the Update contents, please refer to our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/vrinvaders/announcements/detail/563351089208850237]Update 2.0 announcement post[/url]

notes.title: Update 2.0 Live Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/07/1487324138-ezgif-com-d0f3baf2d9.gif[/img]

[h1]Greetings Divers![/h1]

It has been three months since the initial release of VR Invaders, and we are excited to finally announce the release of the [b]VR Invaders Update 2.0[/b] for Steam VR (HTC Vive and Oculus Rift).

The update will release on the [b]20th of February 2017[/b] and will download automatically when you start the game for the next time after then.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27156172/bf6fb9608e3570439b64ec3b80bfaa1aeae5ce3f.png[/img]
[h1]UPDATE 2.0 CONTENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*][h1]Removed StarForce DRM[/h1]The game can now be installed on as many machines as you would like.
[*][h1]Introduced destructible level elements.[/h1] Blast through enemy cover and leave a trail of destruction as you progress through the game.
[*][h1]Added the “Survival” game mode.[/h1] Fight against hordes of enemies and try to survive for as long as you can.
[*][h1]Miscellanous[/h1]Made various small improvements to performance.
[/list]

We hope you will have as much fun with this update as we had developing it!

- The VR Invaders Team
